title: Your First Weekend at Bethel University, Shared as Cards
description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Arrive for Move-In Day
cards.subtitle: The start of Welcome Week
cards.notes: Enter via the west entrance where student teams help haul gear to your room. Check in at the Brushaber Commons Atrium to get your ID card and orientation materials.
cards.short_summary: Kick off your college experience with a high-energy move-in process supported by student leaders.
cards.evidence_claim: New student move-in involves entering via the west entrance with student teams assisting, followed by check-in at the Brushaber Commons Atrium.
cards.access_notes: Specific move-in time slots are assigned to students; check-in typically runs from 8:15 a.m. to 1:30 p.m.

cards.title: First Meal at Monson
cards.subtitle: Brushaber Commons Level 3
cards.notes: Swipe your new ID to enjoy a buffet-style lunch. It is a central hub for meeting floor mates and fueling up between orientation sessions.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus dining hall offering a variety of stations and community seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Monson Dining Center is located on Level 3 of Brushaber Commons and serves as the main dining location for students on meal plans.
cards.access_notes: Open daily during academic terms; students use meal plan swipes for entry.

cards.title: Welcome Kickoff Celebration
cards.subtitle: Official University Welcome
cards.notes: Gather with the entire incoming class for the official kickoff. This high-energy event marks the transition from family time to student life.
cards.short_summary: A large-scale assembly in the university's premier performing arts venue to welcome new Royals.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kickoff Celebration is the official welcome for students and the final farewell for families, held in Benson Great Hall.
cards.access_notes: Typically held on the first evening of Welcome Week; arrive 15 minutes early for seating.

cards.title: Late Night Glo Party
cards.subtitle: Brushaber Commons Level 2
cards.notes: Head to the Underground for a late-night social event with music and dancing. It is a staple of the first weekend for meeting new people.
cards.short_summary: A high-energy social gathering featuring music and neon themes to help students connect.
cards.evidence_claim: The Glo Party is a scheduled late-night event during Welcome Week, often held in The Underground or similar campus spaces.
cards.access_notes: Usually starts around 9:30 p.m. during orientation weekend.

cards.title: Morning Coffee at Royal Grounds
cards.subtitle: The Campus Living Room
cards.notes: Grab a Caribou Coffee or a Bruegger's Bagel. This is the go-to spot for a quick breakfast or a casual meeting with your new roommate.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus coffee shop serving Caribou Coffee and snacks in a central social space.
cards.evidence_claim: Royal Grounds is located in Brushaber Commons and serves Caribou Coffee and Bruegger's Bagels.
cards.access_notes: Open from 7:30 a.m. on weekdays; weekend hours vary during special events.

cards.title: Walk the Nature Trail
cards.subtitle: Scenic Lake Valentine Loop
cards.notes: Take a break from sessions to walk the one-mile loop around Lake Valentine. It is a peaceful way to explore the wooded perimeter of campus.
cards.short_summary: A one-mile nature trail circling the campus and offering views of Lake Valentine.
cards.evidence_claim: The Russell W. Johnson Nature Trail is a one-mile loop that circles the campus and passes by Lake Valentine.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk for walking and running.

cards.title: Play a Round of Disc Golf
cards.subtitle: Top-Ranked Campus Course
cards.notes: Challenge your new friends to a round on this 18-hole course. It winds through the woods and is free for students to use anytime.
cards.short_summary: A highly-rated 18-hole disc golf course located on the north side of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Bethel's 18-hole disc golf course is ranked among the top college courses and is free for student use.
cards.source_title: 10 Fun Things to Do on Bethel's Campus
cards.access_notes: Course begins near Chalberg Hall; open during daylight hours.

cards.title: Kresge Kickoff
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Community Festival
cards.notes: Enjoy live music, inflatable games, and carnival food in the courtyard. This Friday night event is the first major social of the semester.
cards.short_summary: An annual outdoor festival hosted by Student Government to celebrate the start of the year.
cards.evidence_claim: Kresge Kickoff is a Friday night event featuring music, food, and games in the Kresge Courtyard.
cards.access_notes: Typically held from 7:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. on the first Friday of the term.

cards.title: Vespers Under the Lights
cards.subtitle: Sunday Night Worship
cards.notes: Join a student-led worship service at the stadium. It is a signature tradition for grounding yourself before the first week of classes begins.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing Sunday evening worship tradition, now often held outdoors at the stadium.
cards.evidence_claim: Vespers is a student-led Sunday evening worship service that has recently been held under the lights at Royal Stadium.
cards.source_title: Vespers under the lights | Bethel University
cards.access_notes: Held Sunday evenings; check campus schedules for specific start times.

cards.title: Pick Up Your Textbooks
cards.subtitle: Brushaber Commons Level 2
cards.notes: Finalize your weekend by grabbing your books before Monday. You can also pick up some Royal blue gear to show your school spirit.
cards.short_summary: The official university bookstore for textbooks, apparel, and supplies.
cards.evidence_claim: The Campus Store is located on Level 2 of Brushaber Commons and is the primary location for textbook pickup.
cards.access_notes: Open during Welcome Week with extended hours for textbook pickup.
